result.instructions: Tools for OpenWater, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which applications were submitted to our spring grant program this week?"; "Show every judge evaluation for application 1234, with the scores."; "List the sessions that our program chair is responsible for.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes OpenWater data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run openwater_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run openwater_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run openwater_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. openwater_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: openwater_list_programs
tools.title: List programs
tools.description: List the programs (awards, grants, scholarships or events) of this organization, with their rounds and categories. Good first call to find a programId. OpenWater API: GET /v2/Programs.

pageSize.description: Results per page (vendor default when omitted).

tools.name: openwater_get_program
tools.title: Get a program
tools.description: Get one program by id, with its rounds and application categories. OpenWater API: GET /v2/Programs/{id}.

tools.name: openwater_list_applications
tools.title: List applications
tools.description: List applications (submissions), optionally for one program. Filter by time to find recent or finalized ones. OpenWater API: GET /v2/Applications.

programId.description: Only applications of this program id.

userId.description: Only applications of this user id (the applicant).

code.description: Only the application with this code.

pageSize.description: Results per page (vendor default when omitted).

tools.name: openwater_get_application
tools.title: Get an application
tools.description: Get one application by id: its program, applicant, category, collaborators and per-round submission status. OpenWater API: GET /v2/Applications/{id}.

tools.name: openwater_list_users
tools.title: List users
tools.description: List users (applicants, judges, session chairs and staff) with optional filters. Passwords are never returned. OpenWater API: GET /v2/Users.

thirdPartyId.description: Your own id for the person, if you set one.

pageSize.description: Results per page (vendor default when omitted).

tools.name: openwater_get_user
tools.title: Get a user
tools.description: Get one user by id, with role flags and profile field values. OpenWater API: GET /v2/Users/{id}.

tools.name: openwater_create_user
tools.title: Create a user
tools.description: Create a user (for example an applicant). Adds a new record. Sends no e-mail unless suppress_emails is false. OpenWater API: POST /v2/Users.

email.description: E-mail address; it is the login of the new user.

third_party_id.description: Your own unique id for the person.

is_applicant.description: Mark the user as an applicant.

suppress_emails.description: Stop OpenWater from e-mailing the people affected (default true).

tools.name: openwater_update_user
tools.title: Update a user
tools.description: Change the name, e-mail or your own third-party id of one user. Only the fields you pass are sent. Passwords cannot be set here. OpenWater API: PATCH /v2/Users/{id}.

suppress_emails.description: Stop OpenWater from e-mailing the people affected (default true).

tools.name: openwater_list_evaluations
tools.title: List evaluations
tools.description: List judge evaluations (scores and notes) for a program, round, application or judge. OpenWater API: GET /v2/Evaluations.

pageSize.description: Results per page (vendor default when omitted).

tools.name: openwater_list_sessions
tools.title: List sessions
tools.description: List the sessions (event slots or panels) of a program, optionally for one session chair. OpenWater API: GET /v2/Sessions.

pageSize.description: Results per page (vendor default when omitted).

tools.name: openwater_list_funds
tools.title: List funds
tools.description: List the funds (grant or award budgets) of this organization. OpenWater API: GET /v2/Funds.

pageSize.description: Results per page (vendor default when omitted).
